title: Log viewer with SSE follow
outcome: TestRunLog.tsx with an SSE client modeled on ui/src/api-terminal.ts:80; bounded ring buffer; follow toggle (auto-scroll only when following), wrap, jump to end; stops when the server closes the stream (stage terminal); aborts on unmount.
acceptance:
- Follow stops when the stream ends; no reconnect loop.
- Buffer never exceeds its bound.
- Unmount aborts the request (no leaked EventSource/fetch).
